name: ConfirmDialog
summary: Alert dialog for a decision that cannot be taken back.

props.name: open
props.description: REQUIRED. You own the state, as in Dialog and Drawer.

props.name: title
props.description: REQUIRED. The question, in the words of the thing at stake — "Delete this article?", not "Are you sure?".

props.name: description
props.description: REQUIRED, and it is a prop rather than children because it is the node behind aria-describedby: only what goes through it gets announced. Say what is lost and whether it comes back.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Name the action, not the agreement: "Delete" tells the reader what the button does; "OK" makes them remember the title.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The way out. It is the focused control when the dialog opens.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Turns the confirm button danger. Use it when the action destroys data — not for merely important ones, or the colour stops meaning anything.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: REQUIRED. Fires only on the confirm button. Nothing else in this dialog can reach it.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: REQUIRED. Fires on the cancel button and on Escape. A click outside does NOT close this dialog — that is the difference from Dialog, and it is why an accidental click cannot answer for the user.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon in a 40 circle above the title, as in the reference library's alert dialog.

props.name: iconTone
props.description: The circle's colour. Left out, it follows destructive.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where it sits; auto is at the bottom on a phone and in the middle from 640 up.
